comment: The no-arg verdict cores wired into dicore_verdict, in wire order. gen-core-dispatch.py turns this manifest into core_dispatch.gen.h; the freshness guard in :deviceintelligence's build fails when the manifest changes without regenerating. A new no-arg detector = add a line here + regenerate. Cores that need arguments (apk: shim values + rate-limit cache), count-only summary emitters (native_integrity_critical, art_hook_critical), and the not-wired/not-wired-yet cores stay hand-written in orchestrate.cpp — the manifest documents them as excluded so that decision is visible, not accidental.

cores.note: runtime.root: filesystem + /proc channels; tls_trust_store_tampered is the only CRITICAL.
INTEL_0060 — dex-injection provenance across reachable class loaders.
INTEL_0027 — uname-vs-ABI divergence is definitional on genuine silicon.
INTEL_0047 — CNTVCT/CNTFRQ rate + UDF fault replay; arm64-only (empty elsewhere).
INTEL_0033 — x86_64 CPUID hypervisor evidence for hardware-virtualized emulators.
INTEL_0048 — arm64 device-tree/qemu_pipe markers for native-ARM VMs.
debugger/frida surfaces + composes the four environment probes below the fold.
INTEL_0057 — kill-probe filter + self-held USER_NOTIF listener.
INTEL_0042 — own .text vs the CMake-baked build digest.
INTEL_0018 — fork-exec watchdog heartbeat evidence (seq, mac).
INTEL_0012-side evidence — G10 libart .text vs on-disk file, per-site fields.
own-export prologue snapshot vs live bytes.

excluded.why: needs shim values + the 60s re-hash cache + installs the __meta text hash BEFORE det_native runs — ordering is load-bearing.
REMOVED from the verdict (FP-prone on work profiles/dual-app); kept for the Kotlin-driven path.
NOT WIRED (issue #8): CPU-identity probes false-positive on ChromeOS/WSA; INTEL_0027/0033/0048 cover the ground.
count-only summary emitters: they count CRITICALs directly and emit a single summary record each — hand-written in dicore_verdict.
